Connect to your Twenty CRM instance.

1. Log in to your Twenty workspace.
2. Go to **Settings** → **APIs & Webhooks**.
3. Click **+ Create API key**, give it a name (e.g. "Activepieces"), and copy the generated key.

Twenty filter expression: field[comparat: Twenty filter expression: field[comparator]:value, comma-separated for AND, or and(...), or(...), not(...). Comparators: eq, neq, in, containsAny, is (NULL / NOT_NULL), gt, gte, lt, lte, startsWith, endsWith, like, ilike (% wildcard). Composite fields use dot paths. Examples: emails.primaryEmail[eq]:"ada@example.com", name.firstName[eq]:"Ada", domainName.primaryLinkUrl[ilike]:"%acme%", stage[in]:["MEETING","PROPOSAL"], createdAt[gte]:"2026-01-01".
